project.label: VexWork Foundation
project.purpose: Establish VexWork as the portable work-navigation foundation for cross-repository projects, Workgraph truth, Work Board projections and provider relations without becoming cross-repository source authority.

cards.label: Establish VexWork foundation
cards.purpose: Create one portable work-navigation owner that can relate projects and work across repositories while leaving target repository culture and source authority local.

cards.label: Portable Workgraph
cards.purpose: Source-place portable work identity, lifecycle, relationships and deterministic transition behavior compatible with useful VexLife P0B distinctions.

cards.label: Foundation maturity closure
cards.purpose: Close the pre-VexBoard foundation hardening pass by establishing the regression/coverage floor, adopting segment-owned Workgraph authoring, and migrating portable Project Planning and Project Reconciliation without reopening the already-completed first-foundation outcome.

cards.label: Repository Graph
cards.purpose: Make cross-repository work source-descendable through public/source-safe repository and culture-entry references without consolidating cultures.

cards.label: Work Board
cards.purpose: Provide the familiar Jira/kanban-shaped human projection while preserving Workgraph as the only work lifecycle owner.

cards.label: Public VexWork dashboard
cards.purpose: Make current VexWork Project Board and Parking Lot truth visibly explorable through a stable public read projection without making Vextreme another work-state owner.

cards.label: Runtime persistence owner
cards.purpose: Source-place portable private/current event, snapshot, writer and CURRENT-pointer semantics without using Git commit churn as the runtime database.

cards.label: Human idea intake
cards.purpose: Let a human capture a potential into VexWork without converting that potential into implementation authority or a roadmap commitment.

items.label: Later — Screen Lens Scenario Playground
items.purpose: Preserve the future Screen Lens Scenario Playground: an effect-free third-face experience where a person can run bounded simulations from a source-projected Screen/control, vary source-backed or explicitly proposed scenario state, add/remove/substitute VexBoard-proposed content inside addressable source-backed bounds, preview transient presentation such as snackbars, traverse the next simulated consequence, and reset without mutating VexLife-Android or confusing Scenario/Design Draft truth with current source. Reuse the accepted BoardScenario/BoardPrototype and ScreenDesign/projector seams; admit only the smallest patient-zero extensions when this future work is deliberately activated.

items.label: VexLife Blueprint Source of Truth
items.purpose: Preserve accepted VLBSoT portability/parity proof as predecessor lineage while the unfinished MAUI/Mac target leg is parked; current VexLife construction proceeds through VexLife New Beginnings / VexLife-Prod on accepted VexArchitecture.

items.label: Play/Pause first complete semantic circuit
items.purpose: Preserve the completed Play/Pause semantic/parity thresholds and the exact unfinished target-native residue as historical lineage; do not resume the MAUI/Mac leg unless that target is explicitly wanted again.

items.label: Lived native provider conformance
items.purpose: Park the lived MAUI/provider proof with its dependency. Preserve it as an exact future target proof question, not as a blocker on current VexLife construction.

items.label: Target-native MAUI / MediaElement source admission
items.purpose: Park the unfinished MAUI / MediaElement target-native source admission. It is not a prerequisite for current VexArchitecture or VexLife-Prod; reactivate only if the exact C#/MAUI target becomes a current human outcome.

items.label: Reusable VLBSoT v1
items.purpose: Preserve the reusable-method intention as predecessor lineage; current compiler-constrained semantic construction is being developed in VexLife New Beginnings rather than by resuming this paused practicum.

items.label: Whole-product total feature capacity
items.purpose: Preserve the whole-product portability intention as lineage. Current Origin-outward product construction is owned by VexLife New Beginnings / VexLife-Prod; do not treat this old horizon as a parallel active architecture program.

items.label: Discover Feature Request -> Builder process through one Debug Menu specimen
items.purpose: Use the dark/light-theme request as the first live process specimen: preserve the human goal/return, hold only dependent unknowns, lock known terrain endpoints before filling the middle, investigate current Android identities/owners/HOW before creating new source, and let relationship names/IDs/phases emerge only when the living specimen earns them.

items.label: Later — source-map Settings capabilities
items.purpose: After the first browser/Conversation circuit is real, map Context Window, RAM/resource projection, reasoning visibility, accessible directories, Continuity Mode, Dream Sync and clean-chat/memory controls to their existing rightful source owners. Do not infer backend semantics from the screenshot labels or combine destructive effects merely because one visual button does.

items.label: Independent review — VexStream Origin round-trip architecture
items.purpose: Preserve a later independent review edge for the VexStream living-Origin round trip once the implementation/proof foundation is mature enough to review meaningfully. When activated, pressure-test Origin naming/lineage, content-Origin versus value-binding separation, target realization leakage, construction-admission boundaries, evidence/currentness semantics, duplicated truth and unjustified abstractions. This is deliberately parked while #182/#183 target proof and Origin round-trip construction are still forming; it is advisory evidence and grants no source mutation, approval, merge or Origin-authority acceptance.

items.label: Tech debt — Origin rename propagation through mapped descendants
items.purpose: Preserve the low-priority future need for VexBoard to traverse an accepted Origin's existing semantic, process, source and realization relationships when its reusable name changes: first expose the complete downstream rename plan and support bounded manual propagation, then use the observed process to earn autonomous BoardPatch-style propagation with lineage/currentness proof. The Origin is the design truth; repository placement is secondary, so this does not imply repository fragmentation or a parallel rename registry.

items.label: User tag topology / dynamic stations
items.purpose: Preserve the future product question of user-authored music tags that remain distinct from imported source tags/categories and can drive reusable dynamic stations or smart-playlist rules without pre-deciding identity attachment, persistence ownership, rule language, or playlist materialization.

items.label: Foundational Infrastructure history backfill
items.purpose: Gradually reconstruct completed foundational work into VexWork with provenance so future humans and instances can perceive what was built from a dashboard instead of rediscovering it across repositories and chat history.

items.label: Multiple fulfiller / nearby-route optimization
items.purpose: Preserve the possible later need for assigning fulfillment to multiple people, grouping nearby deliveries, routing/sequencing stops and collecting worker delivery acknowledgement without making dispatch/routing part of the first commerce-pilot completion boundary.

items.label: Persistent Keep Offline / Sync
items.purpose: Preserve the future policy question of keeping an album, artist, playlist, or other collection continuously mirrored as producer membership changes, without conflating it with one-shot Download missing.

items.label: Simplify Connected Services onboarding across computer + phone
items.purpose: Preserve the lived need for one guided setup path that checks Tailscale readiness across computer and phone, asks for protected human-only steps at the right moment, then returns to VexLife pairing/private-route setup without weakening Home, session, reachability, or pairing authority boundaries.

items.label: VexStream Songs filter for Not yet downloaded
items.purpose: Preserve the nice-to-have Songs-level filter that answers which songs on this device are still not downloaded, without making it part of MassDownload completion or authorizing implementation.
